accounting.accountant: GDP composition (Dong, Roth & Su 2019) + analytic Gaussian conversion (Balle & Wang 2018)

noise_seed_rule: private per-client run seed + round/client derivation; seed artifact excluded from public metrics

privacy_config.accountant_description: For every client release, sensitivity is at most C and Gaussian standard deviation is at least z*C; T rounds compose by mu-GDP with mu=sqrt(T)/z. No subsampling amplification is claimed.
privacy_config.clip_scope: All floating-point model-state update entries; integer BatchNorm counters are a public function of sample counts
privacy_config.mechanism: client-level Gaussian mechanism on each client's clipped update before encryption
privacy_config.noise_calibration: client k uses std z*C*max(p)/p_k, so its weighted noise contribution alone has std z*C*max(p)
privacy_config.noise_distribution: independent Gaussian per client and round; entropy-seeded generator with private seed artifact
privacy_config.privacy_unit_description: All training data of one simulated client; add/remove-one-client adjacency with fixed public sample weights

selection_note: Round selection uses only the validation split, which is not client data; selecting among released models is post-processing.
